annotations.title: List dentists and staff who take bookings

description: Use this when someone asks which dentists, dental nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice, or which one to book a patient with. Returns up to 100 staff ids and display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or days off.
name: list_clinic_providers

providers.description: Ids and display names of staff with a dentist (doctor), nurse or assistant role. Contact details, role records and clinical data are never returned.
